transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, we're having slower speeds lately, and I'm wondering if we can upgrade our business internet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, Laura. Let me check your current plan. I see you're on our 100 Mbps Business Basic. May I ask how many employees are currently using this connection?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We have around 25 people, and we've also added some cloud-based tools recently.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. Based on your usage, I'd recommend upgrading to our Business Pro 500 plan, which offers 500 Mbps and prioritization for video calls and large file transfers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds good. What would the monthly charge be for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It would be $149 per month, and we're currently waiving installation fees for all upgrades this month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hmm, that's a bit more than I expected. Is there any room to negotiate that price?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check with my manager. Alternatively, we do have a 300 Mbps plan at $119 if that better suits your budget.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually, I think we'll go with the 500 Mbps. Let's proceed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect! I'll send over the digital agreement and schedule the upgrade for Monday. Anything else I can help with today?
